title_cn: 内塔尼亚胡与特朗普在白宫会面
summary:
Bloomberg News Jerusalem Reporter Dan Williams discussed the complex and often tense relationship between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and US President Donald Trump during their recent meeting at the White House. Williams noted that while past tensions have not derailed their relationship, the current talks are shrouded in strategic ambiguity, with speculation about whether the leaders are negotiating a shift in Israel's stance on the Iran conflict or exploring renewed cooperation.  He speaks with Joe Mathieu on the early edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power."
  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former VP Mike Pence on Lindsey Graham's Legacy, Ukraine and Iran
title_cn: 前副总统迈克·彭斯谈林赛·格雷厄姆的遗产、乌克兰和伊朗
summary: Former US Vice President Mike Pence reflects on the life and foreign-policy legacy of Senator Lindsey Graham, calling him a "tenacious advocate for American freedom at home and abroad." Pence says the greatest tribute to Graham would be for the Senate to advance tough new sanctions on Russia and "marshal the West again" in support of Ukraine. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Administration to End Drug Plan Subsidy for Medicare
title_cn: 特朗普政府将终止医疗保险药物计划补贴
summary: The Trump administration intends to end a subsidy program that helped lower costs for Medicare drug plans, a move that could potentially raise monthly costs for older adults.

title: Incoming Tech Earnings, Fed Decision Day | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 7/28/2026
title_cn: 即将发布的科技财报，美联储决策日|彭博商业周刊日报 7/28/2026
summary: The Fed kicks off the second two-day policy meeting under Chair Kevin Warsh's leadership. Bloomberg's Economics & Policy Correspondent Mike McKee has the preview. Plus, Wednesday kicks off a massive round of tech earnings from some of the industry's biggest names including Meta, Microsoft, and Apple. Bloomberg Intelligence's Global Head of Technology Research Mandeep Singh talks about what he'll be looking out for. title: Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang Defends Open-Weight AI Models
title_cn: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋捍卫开放权重人工智能模型
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang defended open-weight artificial intelligence systems as crucial to the nascent AI industry, sending a cautionary message to officials in Washington who are debating how to respond to a surprise breakthrough from Chinese startup Moonshot.
